core.email.description-where-the-theatre: Where the theatre's email comes from. Nothing is sent, including sign-in links, until the sending domain is verified.
core.email.label-how-to-set: How to set up the sending domain
core.email.unavailable.workers-dev: This site is on workers.dev, which cannot send email from its own address. Add a custom domain to the Worker and open the site there to set email up automatically.
core.email.unavailable.local: This site has no public domain yet, so email cannot be set up automatically here. Give the Worker a custom domain in Cloudflare, then record it as the site's address.
core.email.unavailable.no-token: First save a Cloudflare API token with Email Sending edit and Zone read, just above. Then a button here sets the domain up.
core.email.setting-up-detail: A test message goes to the contact address in a few minutes, once Cloudflare accepts it.
core.email.test-went-detail: It went to the contact address. Email can now be sent.
core.email.replace-consequence: Email will come from {domain} instead, once Cloudflare has set it up and a test message has passed.
core.email.says.verified: Email is sent from this domain.
core.email.says.unset: No domain is set, so nothing is sent yet. Choose how to set one up.
core.email.says.test: A test message goes to the theatre's contact email.
core.email.says.no-contact: Set the theatre's contact email in the organisation settings first: the test message goes there.
core.email.automatic-help: Proscenium asks Cloudflare to set up {domain} for sending and to add its DNS records, then sends a test message once Cloudflare accepts it. The word before the site's address is the sending label, below.
core.email.heading.label: Sending label
core.email.label-note: Email keeps coming from {domain}. A new label only takes effect the next time the domain is set up automatically.
core.email.preview-caption: How the end of every email looks
core.email.preview-body: Thank you for booking with us. We look forward to seeing you.
core.branding-page.accent-invalid: Enter a colour as # and six letters or digits, such as #1d4ed8.
core.branding-page.logo-help: Shown in the site's header, on emails and on PDFs. Without one, the theatre's name is shown.
core.branding-page.logo-dark-help: Optional: a version for dark backgrounds. Without one, the main logo is used there too.
core.branding-page.preview-help: As people will see it once saved. Status colours, such as warnings, stay the same whatever the brand.
